name: Melbourne Skydeck
description: See Melbourne from the observation deck. This suggested visit covers general admission; additional experiences are separate.
reviewNotes: Operator identifies the observation deck at Riverside Quay, Southbank, Melbourne 3006. Current ordinary hours apply through 4 April 2027. New Year’s Eve has shorter hours and is excluded from this supply record. The 60-minute visit is a planning estimate, not an operator duration. No ticket quote, reservation, coordinates, accessibility suitability or transfer has been verified.

name: Top of Europe Magic Park — Kursaalgarten
description: Visit the winter event in Kursaalgarten, with an ice rink, ice hockey minigolf and a winter lounge. Choose activities for your experience level; skating conditions and rental availability need checking on the day.
reviewNotes: Organizer identifies Magic Park at Kursaalgarten as successor to Ice Magic. Published season December 18, 2026 through February 28, 2027. Monday–Friday 15:00–22:00, weekends 11:00–22:00; this conservative shared window uses 15:00–22:00 every day. Holiday exceptions excluded. The 90 minutes is a planning estimate; last-entry cutoff, prices, booking, equipment, weather and individual suitability are not verified. No old Ice Magic coordinates or images are reused.

name: Museum of Copenhagen
description: Explore the city’s history indoors. Use the street-level lift entrance; the museum publishes lift access throughout. Confirm operational lifts and your onward route before travel.
reviewNotes: Operator lists weekday opening 10:00–17:00, ticket sales end 30 minutes before closing. This record is restricted to the reviewed Monday–Wednesday acceptance dates. Street lift and internal lifts do not certify every onward route or individual mobility requirement. Duration is a planning estimate; no reservation, coordinates or transfer time is certified.

name: Fruitmarket
description: Visit the gallery via the level Market Street entrance and automatic door. The operator lists an 80 cm clear gallery-lift door and accessible toilets. Use Market Street rather than the Scotsman Steps; confirm the specific exhibition and route before travel.
reviewNotes: Operator lists gallery spaces open daily 11:00–18:00. Level entrances, 80 cm east gallery lift door, accessible toilets and seating are documented; this does not certify all clearances for the requested 65 cm wheelchair or street transfers. Exhibition installation closures and availability need confirmation. Duration is a planning estimate; no reservation, coordinates or transfer time is certified.

name: St. Beatus Cave Museum

reviewNotes: Operator explicitly publishes winter museum hours daily 12:00–17:30, distinct from cave admission.
